---
title: Chapter from YAML
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['h1.title span.chapter-number']
        - []
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['h1.title']
        matches: ['^\s*1\s+Chapter from YAML\s*$']
---

A book chapter whose title comes from the YAML `title` key keeps the chapter number Quarto computes for it. The document's own `title` value must not replace the numbered title.
